$comment: Closed vocabularies every SDK spells identically. `pnpm gen:constants` generates one constant group per enum in every SDK (tools/gen-sdk-constants.ts). These are the CANONICAL values; the values each SDK sends today are aligned to them by P1b-04, not here. Outlets, transports, pack types, patch strategies and bindings are added when their owners define them (P2b-02, P4-01).

enums.name: platform
enums.description: OS family, the canonical `X-PKey-Platform` value (README §3.1). iPadOS is `ios`.

enums.name: arch
enums.description: CPU architecture, the canonical `X-PKey-Arch` value (README §3.1). `universal` and `any` are artifact values, not header values, and are not listed.
